data: Gao et al. Dryad; files failing checks excluded (empty, not epoched, no baseline, malformed, duplicated: both copies); epochs with any EEG channel |x|>100 uV rejected; 0-998 ms, 12 EEG channels, resampled 500->128 Hz
folds: leave-one-pair-out: fold k holds out lying subject k + honest subject k (15 folds)
trial_task: target (1) vs irrelevant (0); probe epochs never used for training
standardization: per-channel mean/sd from training epochs only

models.LDA: shrinkage LDA on 12 ch x 8 windows (125 ms) mean amplitudes
models.SVM: linear SVM C=1, balanced class weights, same features
models.EEGNet: F1=8 D=2 F2=16, kernel 64, dropout 0.5, Adam 1e-3, batch 64, max 30 epochs, early stopping patience 5 on inner validation (2 held-out training pairs)
models.CNN-LSTM: temporal conv 8x32 + depthwise spatial (D=2) + pool 4 -> LSTM(32) -> linear; same training

person_score: within-person AUC = P(model score on probe epoch > score on irrelevant epoch)
person_decision: knowledgeable if one-sided permutation test (2000 shuffles) of mean probe vs irrelevant score gives p < 0.05
classic_baseline: same decision rule on Pz mean amplitude 300-800 ms (no machine learning); Pz = row 1 in the row order from the raw .cnt header
metrics: trial AUC target vs irrelevant (held-out persons); person AUC (30 persons) from within-person AUC; sensitivity, specificity, balanced accuracy with Wilson 95% CI; label-permutation p-value for person AUC
correction_2026_10: Channel order corrected from the raw .cnt header (Oz Pz P4 C4 P3 Cz C3 Fz F4 F3 Fp2 Fp1); classical baseline now reads row 1 (= Pz). Settings unchanged.
